import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import heapq

    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    min_char = min(s)
    min_char_index = s.index(min_char)

    if k <= n - min_char_index:
        print(s[min_char_index:min_char_index + k])
    else:
        suffix = s[min_char_index:]
        suffix_len = len(suffix)
        repeat_times = k // suffix_len
        remainder = k % suffix_len

        result = suffix * repeat_times + suffix[:remainder]
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
